description_en: Queries whether an audit transformation object is selected
description_zh: 查询审计转换对象是否入选
name: GetAuditConversionSource

parameters.help_en: The AgentSpace to query. The service verifies access permissions and region matching based on the user identity and region passed by the gateway
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的 AgentSpace。服务结合网关传入的用户身份和地域校验访问权限及地域匹配关系
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: A value of gateway indicates the gateway instance transform list, and a value of trace indicates the service transform list
parameters.help_zh: gateway 表示网关实例转换名单，trace 表示服务转换名单
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transformation object. When the type is gateway, this is the gateway instance ID. When the type is trace, this is the service name. The value is encoded as a single URL path segment. After decoding, leading and trailing whitespace is removed, and intermediate spaces are retained. The normalized value cannot be empty, can be up to 256 UTF-8 bytes in length, and is case-sensitive. For example, cluster A must be encoded as cluster%20A, and %20cluster%20A%20 is normalized to cluster A. A plus sign (+) in the path represents a literal plus sign and cannot be used as a space. If the value contains only whitespace or exceeds the byte limit, a 400 InvalidParameter.Config error is returned. Byte limits and normalization are verified by the backend
parameters.help_zh: gateway 时为网关实例 ID，trace 时为服务名。按单个 URL 路径段编码，解码后去除首尾空白，保留中间空格；规范化后不能为空，最长 256 个 UTF-8 字节，区分大小写。cluster A 应编码为 cluster%20A；%20cluster%20A%20 规范化为 cluster A；路径中的 + 表示加号，不能代替空格。仅空白或超过字节限制时返回 400 InvalidParameter.Config。字节限制和规范化由后端校验
parameters.name: instance_id

schema.description_en: The audit transformation object query result
schema.description_zh: 审计转换对象查询结果

id.description_en: The normalized ID of the transformation object
id.description_zh: 规范化后的转换对象 ID
id.title_en: 规范化后的转换对象 ID
id.title_zh: 规范化后的转换对象 ID

selected.description_en:
Indicates whether the object is selected for the transformation list of the current type. Valid values:
true: The object is selected.
false: The object is not selected. This value is also returned when no audit configuration exists. It does not indicate whether the object is online or the task is healthy
selected.description_zh: true 表示入选当前类型名单，false 表示未入选。没有审计配置时也返回 false，不代表对象在线或任务运行健康
selected.title_en: 是否入选当前 AgentSpace 的转换名单
selected.title_zh: 是否入选当前 AgentSpace 的转换名单

schema.title_en: 审计转换对象查询结果
